verdict.rationale: Direct probe evidence confirms Cerebras serves a working llms.txt at inference-docs.cerebras.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an indexed documentation list, plus .md-suffixed pages that explicitly point agents back to the llms.txt index for full doc traversal. This is exactly the agent-oriented docs pattern the story asks for. missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of an agent actually consuming llms.txt successfully, and no OpenAPI spec available (404s) which would further support machine-driven agent consumption.
